experiment: E13 — head-to-head: frozen-core self-assembly vs full fine-tune at equal optimizer budget, 5 seeds [1,7,42,123,999]
verdict: No capability advantage for self-assembly over fine-tune on the synthetic stream (mean delta_acc -0.12 pts); retention slightly better for self-assembly (mean delta_ret 0.67 pts). Synthetic toy tasks, not language.

verdict_correction_2026_10_09.original_verdict_retention_clause: retention slightly better for self-assembly (mean delta_ret 0.67 pts)
verdict_correction_2026_10_09.correction: delta_ret_pts = A_drop - B_drop, so a POSITIVE delta_ret means self-assembly drops MORE on the old task. Mean old-task drop: self-assembly 1.776 pts vs fine-tune 1.112 pts. Retention favours fine-tune, not self-assembly. Mean of per-seed delta_ret is 0.666; difference of means is 0.664 (rounding). Raw per-seed numbers unchanged.
verdict_correction_2026_10_09.corrected_verdict: No capability advantage for self-assembly over fine-tune (mean delta_acc -0.12 pts), and no retention advantage either: fine-tune retains better on average (mean old-task drop 1.112 vs 1.776 pts). Synthetic toy tasks, not language.
